mutations.contract: The link into drawing-checker is labelled with the drawing's OWN number and revision as the citation states them -- and only where there is a run to link to, since a spec-pile document's `document` is a filename and labelling one would be a category error.
mutations.note: The second of the two, same session and same reason. The mutation keeps the CONDITION and drops the value, so the spec-pile half of the rule still reads as honoured while every drawing link loses its name -- the failure shows up as a link with nothing to call it, not as a crash.
mutations.find:
"drawing_no": (str(source_ref.get("document") or "") or None
                       if resolved["run_dir"] else None),
